title: Explicit morphism of Mayer–Vietoris short complexes
statement: Let h:X→Y be a morphism of schemes, U,V opens of Y, I a complex on X, J a complex on Y, and f:h_*I→J a chain map. The image components of [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data] define a short-complex morphism h_*MV(I,h⁻¹U,h⁻¹V)→MV(J,U,V). Its first component is f, its middle component is the biproduct lift of the two mapped projections followed by the U and V image components, and its third component is the U∩V image component. The squares are supplied by [lem-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-squares].

proof.text: Fix the three components by the stated formulas. Use the two commuting-square equations of [lem-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-squares] to supply only the propositional fields of ShortComplex.homMk; no data is chosen from an existence theorem.

def schemeMVImageChainMap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Y) (U V : Y.Opens)

    (J : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (f : ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ J) :
    (schemeMayerVietorisComplex X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U) (h ⁻¹ᵁ V) I).map
        ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⟶
      schemeMayerVietorisComplex Y U V J
